title: Exchanging a Jacket
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A short conversation about exchanging an item without a paper receipt.

transcript.text: I bought this jacket last week, but the sleeves are too long. I have the email receipt. Could I exchange it for the next size down?
Certainly. That size is in stock, but this colour is online only. Would grey work instead?
Yes. I would rather exchange it today than wait for delivery.

questions.prompt: Why does the customer want a different jacket?
options: The current one has a broken zip.
The colour is different from the picture.
questions.explanation: The customer says the sleeves are too long and asks for the next size down.

questions.prompt: What does the assistant say about the preferred colour?
options: It is available in every size in the shop.
questions.explanation: The assistant says that colour is only available online.

questions.prompt: Why does the customer accept grey?
options: Grey is the only colour they ever wear.
They prefer to take an exchange today rather than wait.
The assistant offers a discount on grey.
questions.explanation: The customer says grey is fine because they would rather exchange it today than wait for delivery.
